faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Silchar is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 31,000/- per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in Electronics, Instrumentation, or ECE from a recognized university or institute, with a specialization in VLSI Design or Microelectronics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position at NIT Silchar is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a specific period as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Silchar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) is located in Silchar, Assam.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Project Associate-I at NIT Silchar is NITS/Dean (RC)/ECE/640/07/2026.
